What does InkOS charge?" — "Nothing. You pay the monthly software fee. Stripe takes its standard processing fee. We add zero on top." - "Will my Vagaro packages convert?" — "Yes. Packages map to InkOS multi-session projects. The discount logic, scheduled visits, and prepaid deposits all carry." - "I run a multi-location chain on Vagaro. Will that work?" — "Yes. InkOS Enterprise supports multi-location with per-location P&L, SSO, and SCIM. Migration runs sequentially — pilot at one location, then roll out." - "What about Vagaro's marketplace? Marketplace traffic ends with Vagaro on day-of cutover; build your own funnel through Marketing module." - "Can I keep using Vagaro during migration?" — "Yes. Standard 14-day parallel run. Cancel Vagaro day-of cutover. We don't bill until you do." **CTA:** ```tsx ``` --- ## Implementation - 4 files total: 2 page.tsx + 2 layout.tsx - Both pages use motion + whileInView reveals on cards - All inline styles `as React.CSSProperties` - Lift MoatCardBright pattern from `src/components/home/work.tsx`. Use ACCENT_MAP for color variants. ## Imports Lucide LayoutGrid, AlertCircle, Shield, Plane, ArrowRight (any others used by MoatCard pattern). ## Verification After all 4 files: `cd "/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Marketing Site/InkOS" && pnpm run type-check`.
